questions.text: How many eyes does a bee have?
questions.fact: Two large eyes and three small ones on top of the head.

questions.text: Up to how many hours a day can a koala sleep?
questions.fact: Its eucalyptus diet gives little energy, so it saves it.

questions.text: Approximately how much does the bee hummingbird, the smallest bird in the world, weigh? (g)
questions.fact: It lives in Cuba and is about 5 cm long.

questions.text: Up to how much food can an elephant eat per day? (kg)
questions.fact: It spends up to 16 hours a day eating.

questions.text: Approximately how many languages are spoken in the world today?
questions.fact: Almost half of them are at risk of disappearing.

questions.text: How many rooms does Buckingham Palace have?
Approximately how tall is the Leaning Tower of Pisa? (m)
questions.fact: It started to lean while it was still being built, in the 12th century.

questions.text: How long is the Great Wall of China, according to the official 2012 survey? (km)
questions.fact: Contrary to popular belief, it is not visible from space with the naked eye.

questions.text: In what year was the first email sent?
questions.fact: Ray Tomlinson picked the @ to separate the user from the computer.

questions.text: How many emojis were in the original set Shigetaka Kurita created in 1999?
questions.fact: The set is part of the collection of MoMA, in New York.

questions.text: Approximately how many seeds does a strawberry have?
questions.fact: The little dots on the outside are actually the strawberry's true fruits.

questions.text: Approximately how many liters of sap does it take to make 1 liter of maple syrup?
questions.fact: The sap is boiled down until only the syrup is left.

questions.text: Approximately how long does it take hair to grow 1 cm? (days)
questions.fact: Each hair grows for 2 to 7 years before it falls out.
